def VTask.ofLeftInverse : {α : Sort u_3} -> {β : Type u_4} -> (f : α → β) -> (f_inv : Nonempty α → β → α) -> (hf : ∀ (h : Nonempty α), Function.LeftInverse (f_inv h) f) -> α ≃ ↑(Set.range f) := by
  intro α β f f_inv hf
  have h₁ : ∀ a : α, ∃ b : β, f b = f a := by
    intro a
    refine' ⟨f a, _⟩
    <;> rfl
  -- We need to construct an equivalence between α and the range of f.
  -- The forward direction sends each a : α to ⟨f a, a, rfl⟩.
  -- The backward direction sends each ⟨y, x, hx⟩ : Set.range f to f_inv ⟨x⟩ y.
  -- We need to prove that these maps are inverses.
  classical
  have h₂ : Nonempty α → Function.Injective f := by
    intro h
    have h₃ : Function.LeftInverse (f_inv h) f := hf h
    exact fun a b h₄ => by
      have h₅ : f_inv h (f a) = a := h₃ a
      have h₆ : f_inv h (f b) = b := h₃ b
      calc
        a = f_inv h (f a) := by rw [h₅]
        _ = f_inv h (f b) := by rw [h₄]
        _ = b := by rw [h₆]
  -- We handle the nonempty and empty cases separately.
  by_cases h₃ : Nonempty α
  · -- Case: Nonempty α
    have h₄ : Function.Injective f := h₂ h₃
    -- Since f is injective, we can use the equivalence from injective functions.
    have h₅ : α ≃ ↑(Set.range f) := Equiv.ofInjective f (by
      intro x y hxy
      exact h₄ hxy)
    exact h₅
  · -- Case: Empty α
    -- When α is empty, both sides are empty and the equivalence is trivial.
    have h₄ : IsEmpty α := by
      refine' ⟨fun a => _⟩
      exact h₃ ⟨a⟩
    have h₅ : IsEmpty (↑(Set.range f)) := by
      refine' ⟨fun ⟨y, x, hx⟩ => _⟩
      -- Since α is empty, there cannot be any x : α.
      exact h₄ x
    -- The equivalence between two empty types is trivial.
    exact ⟨fun a => False.elim (h₄ a), fun y => False.elim (h₅ y), by simp [h₄, h₅], by simp [h₄, h₅]⟩
